reviews.comment: As an introvert, I found this class extremely intimidating at first, but I wound up loving it. Dr. Burnham makes the discussion questions interesting and puts you in groups with your peers to talk it out. There are 10 pop quizzes and 2 oral exams. If you show up to class, it's easy. He's also accommodating during the exams, 10/10 course and prof!!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Burnham quickly became my favorite professor. He was genuinely committed to helping us stretch our thinking. He made complex concepts easy to grasp & encouraged us to understand new perspectives. Great organization and casual teaching style. I felt like I learned everything with confidence. Truly an amazing instructor. 10/10 recommend
